articles.title: U.S. Navy, Republic of Korea Navy conclude combined Maritime Mine Countermeasures Exercise 2026
articles.summary: The U.S. Navy, Republic of Korea (ROK) Navy, and 15 partner nations successfully concluded the ninth Multi-National Mine Warfare Exercise 2026 (MNMIWEX 26) off the southeast coast of Busan, Oct. 16, 2026.

articles.title: Bridging Cultures: Japanese youth, U.S. Soldiers find common ground
articles.summary: CAMP ZAMA, Japan – Soldiers here hosted a community outreach event Oct. 3 to strengthen ties and build cross-cultural connections with local Japanese youth through a day of interactive games, a shared meal, and shared fellowship.

articles.title: Arctic experiment explores ways to close air surveillance gaps
articles.summary: U.S. military personnel, scientists and international partners conducted live-fly testing Sept. 7–11, 2026, during the final event of a three-year Arctic air domain awareness experiment series, collecting data to assess technology that could help close surveillance gaps across Alaska.

articles.title: Clackamas Fire and Military Responders Conduct Structural Collapse and Air Mobility Joint Training Exercise
articles.summary: Members of the Clackamas Fire Department, Oregon Army National Guard, Oregon Air National Guard, Air Force Reserve, U.S. Coast Guard, and CHAIS, which provides professional handlers and working dogs, participated in a simulated tsunami response mission on October 15, 2026, at Camp Rilea Armed Forces Training Center near Warrenton, Oregon.

articles.title: San Diego Native Named Motivator of the Month While Serving with Navy Medicine in Cuba
articles.summary: Courtesy story by Ashley Craig, Navy Office of Community Outreach MILLINGTON, Tenn. – Hospitalman Kimberly MartinezInfante, a native of San Diego, California, was recently named Motivator of the Month while serving aboard U.S. Navy Medicine Readiness and Training Command (USNMRTC) Guantanamo Bay at U.S. Naval Hospital Guantanamo Bay, Cuba.

articles.title: Logistics exchange strengthens Washington Guard, Malaysia military partnership
articles.summary: Logistics experts from the Washington National Guard and Royal Malaysian Armed Forces participated in a subject matter expert exchange at Camp Murray, Wash., Sept. 21-25, 2026.

articles.title: Pentagon, BAE sign deal for up to 25,000 precision-guided munition kits a year
articles.summary: The Pentagon and BAE Systems signed a framework agreement for up to 25,000 Advanced Precision Kill Weapon System, or APKWS, guidance kits a year.

articles.summary: Senior leader highlights the command’s support to U.S. Forces Korea and regional deterrence.
